EABL’s culture is rooted in a deep sense of our purpose -
‘Celebrating life, every day, everywhere’ -, the personal
connections our people have to our brands, our
relationships with each other and our passion to win.
Our people create our culture and they keep it strong.

70-20-10
A philosophy of 70-20-10 principle has been adopted for
development with 70% practice and experience coming
from one’s day to day job, 20% through coaching and
mentoring, and 10% from formal traditional learning
experience including training and e-learning.
